notes: τά is unrepresented because the ASV compresses τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν to of us and writes no nominal for the substantival article — rule 36's own compressed case.
ἄχρι → as far as heads on far: rule 71 settles an improper preposition's frame on its lexical word and never on the initial as.
The ASV inverts Ἀππίου Φόρου to The Market of Appius; the two names are split rather than sharing a head (rules 26, 28), and the supplied determiners go to the nouns under rule 58.
